neurotypical.name: Neurotypical
neurotypical.description: Default profile. Standard default skill behavior; base authoring layer.
guidanceDeltas: Base authoring layer describes standard neurotypical behavior.
neurotypical.promptInstructions: Adapt content for a general neurotypical learner: standard clear explanations, balanced pacing (15-45 min), and standard difficulty progression.

autism.name: Autism Spectrum
autism.description: Autistic learners. Prioritizes predictability, visual support, literal language, and errorless learning.
guidanceDeltas: Vocabulary: Use literal language. 5-12 word sentences. No idioms or sarcasm.
One concept per activity: split multi-concept lessons.
Predictability: keep lesson flow fixed across the course.
Visual first: images carry primary meaning, text is secondary.
outputDeltas: activityPlan progression: observe -> guided_practice -> independent_practice -> mastery_check -> positive_completion
autism.promptInstructions: Adapt content for an autistic learner: use strict literal language (5-12 words per sentence, no idioms/metaphors), direct step-by-step instructions, one concept per activity, predictable structure, visual emphasis, and calm non-exaggerated feedback.

school.name: School (K-12)
school.description: School-age learners (K-12). Age-graded register, curriculum-aligned objectives, grade-band-appropriate pacing.
guidanceDeltas: Vocabulary: match the grade band (concrete to academic).
Objectives: align to stated curriculum and grade band.
Activity instructions: direct, concrete, sequential instructions.
outputDeltas: lesson.estimatedMinutes use grade-band appropriate pacing range [15, 45]
school.promptInstructions: Adapt content for K-12 school learners: age-appropriate vocabulary and grade-band pacing, concrete visual examples, curriculum-aligned objectives, and direct step-by-step activity instructions.

college.name: College / Adult
college.description: Higher-education / adult learners. Academic rigor, independence, disciplinary terminology, and deeper conceptual treatment.
guidanceDeltas: Objectives: prefer higher-order objectives (apply, analyze, evaluate).
Examples: realistic disciplinary examples and authentic problems.
Pacing: deeper, longer learning blocks (20-60 min).
college.promptInstructions: Adapt content for college/adult learners: formal disciplinary register, higher-order objectives (apply, analyze, evaluate), realistic case-based examples, deeper independent learning blocks (20-60 min).
